name: Unwip 0.43.13
body:
A small fix:
- Pressing Sync (or anything else that refreshes the main screen) no longer swaps the inspiration quote. It stays the same while Unwip is open. Press ↻ on the quote for a new one, and you get a fresh one each time you open Unwip.
